verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline and the date/address together as one block next to the image, so the hierarchy and reading order hold. However, the whole group sits as a small island in the middle, with large dead margins on the left and right. The striped image has also lost the original's full-height edge bleed, and the headline runs almost to the top edge. B breaks the design into three scattered pieces: the headline is on the left, the image floats in the centre, and the date/address is stranded far to the right. That separates the event details from their headline, and the details text is small and isolated in empty space.
